title: Clowder AI Plugin Manifest (v0.1)
description: Machine-readable truth source for the static plugin.yaml access protocol (§3.4/§3.5). beta.24 adds operation row actions (render 'row', typed rows results, ActionDef.confirm), the module data directory (runtime.dataDirectory, capability data.directory), and the cloud-conversation-host contribution (capability cloud.conversation.host), while preserving the beta.22 message-subscription presentation and the beta.20 media, presentation, lifecycle, and media-source authority boundaries.

PluginParticipantWithAvailability.description: Explicit quota availability snapshot returned only for includeAvailability:true; not native capability or invocation authority.

includeAvailability.description: Opt-in only; omission preserves the strict legacy participant shape.

SemVer.description: SemVer 2.0.0 including optional prerelease and build metadata.

strategy.description: User-visible/relationship data MUST be retained or ask-on-uninstall. lifecycle is structurally forbidden (铁律 #5: user state defaults to persistent).

RequiredWhen.description: Makes the containing field conditionally required and overrides its required flag. The condition compares against the referenced field's effective value (stored value, otherwise default); an array matches when any listed value is strictly equal.

required.description: Makes the field unconditionally required unless requiredWhen is present; requiredWhen overrides this flag.

hidden.description: Hide a value field from manual owner editing while retaining it as an operation target or runtime value.

requiredWhen.description: Overrides required and makes this field required only when the referenced field's effective value (stored value, otherwise default) strictly equals value, or any member when value is an array.

target.description: Configuration keys whose values are backfilled when the operation succeeds; operation fields use contract key rather than the legacy Host name property.

ActionDef.description: One Host-rendered operation action. render is closed to the renderers the frontend implements: 'row' actions are not rendered standalone and can only be invoked from a row of a 'rows' result in the same operation.

confirm.description: Plain text (1..200 chars). Applies to button and row actions: the Host must ask the owner to confirm before every invocation when the manifest declares it; a row-level confirm can only replace the wording, never skip the confirmation step.

OperationRows.description: Typed payload of an operation result whose render is 'rows': a bounded, Host-rendered row list. Runtime data is validated by the contract-exported rows validator against the declaring operation, fail-closed.

OperationRow.description: One row of a 'rows' result. The hard storage ceiling behind a row list is 32 authorizations; stay well below the 200-row schema bound.

OperationRowAction.description: Invocation of one render-'row' ActionDef of the same operation, carrying this row's input. Host validates the reference fail-closed: undeclared, or referencing a non-row action, invalidates the whole result.

label.description: Defaults to the referenced ActionDef label.

confirm.description: Replaces the referenced ActionDef confirm wording; it can never remove the confirmation step the manifest declared.

mode.description: Original connector setup visibility: show this step when the connectionMode configuration value matches.

ConnectorPermissions.description: Original connector group settings declaration. The label names the owner UI; this does not grant Host capabilities or contain permission state.

McpActionMethod.description: A native MCP method allowlist entry, without fixed business parameters.

actions.description: Module methods callable by this native MCP server; these do not publish direct tools.

CloudConversationHostContribution.description: Declares that this package hosts one cloud conversation provider: the Host sends owner cloud-cat messages through appendMessage and pulls assistant returns through assistantReturns.list / ack. Method semantics come from the manifest only; runtime data can never introduce new methods. Error codes are data (external-process transports flatten thrown errors): NEEDS_BINDING / BOUND_CONVERSATION_MISMATCH -> needs-binding (incl. h4); HOST_UNAVAILABLE -> treated as no adapter (null); every other code (the STALE_* revisions, AMBIGUOUS_EFFECT, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION, HOST_STOPPED, PAIRING_REJECTED, ...) and any unknown code -> host-append-failed. HOST_UNAVAILABLE must only describe failures before a request could have had any effect (no pairing record, missing socket, connection refused); any error after the request was written is AMBIGUOUS_EFFECT. The owning feature must be granted cloud.conversation.host; one provider accepts at most one enabled package.

CloudConversationAppendMessageInput.description: Host -> package input of the appendMessage method. idempotencyKey references the shared MessageId (1..512) and is the Clowder source message id; the package answers failed + INVALID_REQUEST when the key does not match its own token format. text is additionally checked in code: UTF-8 <= 128 KiB and non-empty after trim (isCloudConversationTextBudget).

CloudConversationAppendMessageAppendedRe.description: Successful append. providerMessageId is the provider-side (ChatGPT) message id; the Host's generic adapter maps it back to its internal hostMessageId.

CloudConversationAppendMessageFailedResu.description: Failed append. errorCode is a safe string; diagnostic is the contract copy of CloudBridgeFailureDiagnosticV1 and is re-validated by the contract-exported isCloudBridgeFailureDiagnosticV1. A Host that preserves errorCode while dropping an invalid diagnostic validates in two stages: validate the envelope without diagnostic, then validate diagnostic separately.

CloudConversationReturnCursor.description: Assistant-return cursor: the after? triplet is either fully present or fully absent.

CloudConversationAssistantReturn.description: One candidate assistant return. sourceMessageId echoes the appendMessage idempotencyKey (the Clowder source message id). content is additionally checked in code: UTF-8 <= 128 KiB and non-empty after trim.

CloudConversationListInput.description: Host -> package input of the assistantReturns.list method. Returns at most one return per call (the native inbox delivers one per poll; a single content can reach ~768 KiB after JSON escaping, so two would risk the 1 MiB frame bound).

CloudConversationAckInput.description: Host -> package input of the assistantReturns.ack method.

CloudConversationAckFailedResult.description: Failed ack. ASSISTANT_RETURN_NOT_FOUND means the return is already settled and must not be retried. A Host that preserves errorCode while dropping an invalid diagnostic validates in two stages: validate the envelope without diagnostic, then validate diagnostic separately.

SemanticMaterializerDeclaration.description: Optional independent DOCX computation. The Host admits one closed worker bundle under the installed package and live feature authority, in a fresh sandboxed private browser process with no ambient effects. This is not permission to execute package code in the Host or renderer.

DesktopWindowContribution.description: Host-created desktop surface under its owning feature's windows.create grant. surface.integrity verifies only the entry HTML bytes. The Host must separately verify the complete installed package and serve a verified snapshot of all referenced assets. This declares no executable, Host origin, identity, or capture permission. The Host owns window execution, media/session admission and the isolated receive-only provider channel.

sandbox.description: Host serves the renderer from an origin that has no Host cookies or Host APIs, applies sandbox=allow-scripts allow-same-origin, and sends a frame-ancestors response header restricted to the exact Host origin.

navigationPolicy.description: The renderer must install a fail-closed Navigation API listener before upstream code and prevent every self-navigation before its request starts.

capabilities.description: @signed(G-0 2026-07-15) — capability vocabulary is contract-versioned (P15). Adding a new capability = new contract version. Unknown strings are structurally rejected at schema level; authorization is a separate host runtime layer. Lifecycle callbacks are protocol-intrinsic baseline behavior, so they are not grantable or revocable capability IDs.

dataDirectory.description: Single-segment module data directory name ('.' and '..' are excluded by the pattern). The Host creates <projectRoot>/.cat-cafe/plugin-host/<name> (0700) before start and only packages granted the data.directory capability receive it; omit to derive the name from the plugin id. Uninstall retains the directory (owner data).

version.description: Plugin version — must be valid semver (§9: numeric prerelease identifiers MUST NOT have leading zeroes).

contractVersion.description: Must be an exact published semver version — no ranges, wildcards, or operator prefixes (five-step freeze: pin exact version). §9: numeric prerelease identifiers MUST NOT have leading zeroes.
